From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@bridgecrew.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@bridgecrew.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BridgeCrew onboarding: phased rollout & acceptance gates

Hi all —

Attaching the SOW (v1) and our mutual-action plan. Quick summary for CS:
- Contract signed (attached SOW). Start date: target pilot window Dec 15 — Jan 15.
- Scope: Prod inference for ingestion pipeline (text + embeddings) on Redwood Dedicated. BridgeCrew will use a single VPC peering and SAML SSO.
- Acceptance: pilot will be considered "accepted" after 2 weeks of steady-state traffic (>=50 reqs/min) and operational runbook delivery.

Open / riskiest items I flagged to legal & infra:
1) SSO: BridgeCrew needs Okta metadata confirmed — their security team says they can deliver by Dec 8 but asked for our SAML cert.
2) Data residency: All logs need to stay in us-west-2; they requested a written confirmation on retention and audit logging.
3) Dedicated capacity sizing: recommended N1 (2xA100) for pilot; CS should validate with BridgeCrew's expected QPS profile.

Requests for CS (please reply with owners & ETA):
- Nominate primary CS owner for kickoff and weekly standups.
- Confirm SOC2 evidence to share with BridgeCrew (we have SOC2 summary + sys-description).
- Create the kickoff agenda and pre-kickoff questionnaire for Alex/Priya.

Attachments: BridgeCrew_SOW_v1.pdf, BridgeCrew_MutualActionPlan.xlsx

Ben

Thanks Ben — taking this on. Internal notes / quick plan below (internal only):

Internal note: priority = high (legal/SSO deadline).

Proposed owners / immediate actions:
- CS Lead (kickoff + weekly): Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwood.com) — will run kickoff on Dec 15 morning PT.
- Technical intake / infra liaison: Karthik Iyer (me) — will validate Dedicated pool sizing with infra and PM.
- Contract / billing follow-up: Ben to confirm start-of-billing date vs go-live window.

Phased onboarding outline (draft):
Phase 0 (pre-kickoff, by Dec 10): SSO metadata exchange, confirm VPC peering window, collect sample payloads.
Phase 1 (pilot, Dec 15–Jan 15): deploy model on Dedicated pool, smoke tests, runbook handoff.
Phase 2 (post-pilot, Jan 16–ongoing): scale plan and SLA discussion.

Risks & mitigations:
- SSO delay => mitigation: temporary API-key test tokens for smoke tests (short-lived) — need legal ok.
- Data residency confirmation pending — I'll loop Security for a short note to BridgeCrew.

Tessa — if you can draft the kickoff agenda and questionnaire (one pager), I will prepare the infra checklist and a sizing recommendation.

Karthik

Hi Alex & Priya — great to meet you over email, and congrats on the signed SOW. I’m the CS Lead who will run your implementation.

I’ve attached a short kickoff agenda and a 6-question pre-kickoff questionnaire we ask all customers to complete. High-level plan:
- Kickoff: Tue Dec 15, 10:00–11:00 PT (30 min technical + 30 min ops/BA).
- Ownership: I’ll run weekly standups; Karthik will be the infra/technical liaison for Dedicated pool provisioning.
- Deliverables by pilot end: runbook, acceptance checklist, production smoke-test report.

Pre-kickoff asks (quick):
1) Please share Okta SAML metadata file by Dec 8 (or confirm call to swap certs).
2) Provide sample payloads (anonymized) and target QPS for pilot.
3) Confirm network contact and preferred maintenance windows for VPC peering.

Attachments: kickoff-agenda.docx (includes agenda + proposed attendees), pre-kickoff-questionnaire.pdf (embedded).

If Dec 15 10:00 PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite and an optional prep session for your infra folks on Dec 14.

Best,
